themes.0.title: Asers d temdint
themes.0.desc: Elisa, aglim n uzger, Byrsa, Cothon akked tinmahlin n tgelda tapunit.
themes.0.questions.0.q: Akken i d-tefka tmacahut (umesnezruy agrikan Timée), deg anwa aseggas i tettwasers Qarṭaǧ ?
themes.0.questions.0.explain: Timée n Tauroménion yesres asers azal n 814/813 send Ɛisa. Idlal iqdimen akteṛ i yettwakecfen swayen seg tagara n lqern wis 8 : tamacahut ur tebɛed ara seg tidet.
themes.0.questions.1.q: D acu i d-yebɣa ad yini Qart-Ḥadašt, isem afiniqi n Qarṭaǧ ?
themes.0.questions.1.explain: Deg tefiniqit, qart yebɣa ad yini « tamdint », hadasht « tamaynut » : Ṣur tamaynut deg Afrika. Carthagène, di Hispanya, tesɛa isem-nni s yiman-is.
themes.0.questions.2.q: Akken i d-tettwali tmacahut, amek i tesɛa Elisa tiɣilt n Byrsa ?
themes.0.questions.2.choices.0: Tekseb-itt d lǥuvu seg gma-s Pygmalion
themes.0.questions.2.choices.3: Tezzi-tt s izirigen irqaqen i tgezmen seg uglim n uzger
themes.0.questions.2.explain: Tekseb azal n tmurt i yezmer aglim n uzger ad t-iɣumm, tgezzem-it imbeɛd d izirigen rqiqen armi zzint tiɣilt meṛṛa. Igrikiyen fehhmen akka isem n Byrsa (« aglim »).
themes.0.questions.3.q: Anwa i yenɣan Acherbas (Sychée), argaz n Elisa, iwakken ad yeṭṭef ayla-s ?
themes.0.questions.3.explain: Pygmalion, agellid n Ṣur gma-s n Elisa, yeẓẓa cci deg ssɛaya n Acherbas, ameqqran n ikahinen n Melqart. Lǥerima-agi i yeǧǧan Elisa ad trewl s lebḥer.
themes.0.questions.4.q: Anwa isem i s-fkan Ilibikiyen i Elisa, akken i d-yeqqar Timée ?
themes.0.questions.4.explain: Akken i d-yeqqar Timée, Ilibikiyen semman-as Deidô, « tirurit », ɣef ddeɛwa n tikliwin-is iɣezfen. D isem-agi i yeqbel Virgile.
themes.0.questions.5.q: Mi sellen lqaɛa n temdint, ufan-d aqerru n uyis. D acu i d-yesekken ?
themes.0.questions.5.choices.0: Tamurt yesɛan afellaḥ maca d laɛbudiyya
themes.0.questions.5.explain: Aqerru n uzger yefka-d uqbel tamurt yesɛan afellaḥ maca d laɛbudiyya ; aqerru n uyis, yettwafen akteṛ, yegallan-d agdud n umenɣi yesɛan tazmert.
themes.0.questions.6.q: Acḥal n lbabura n umenɣi i yezmer ad iḥerz lebḥer azir n Qarṭaǧ (Cothon) ?
themes.0.questions.6.explain: Lebḥer n umenɣi azir yesɛa 220 n tkalin yettwaɣummen, yemfaṛaqen s tgejdal ioniques, yal yiwet tḥerz lbabur n umenɣi. Yeldi kan seg lebḥer n ttjara.
themes.0.questions.7.q: Azwel « sufeṭ », i yeṭṭfen sin yimḥekmen ițwafernen yal aseggas, yekka-d seg wawal afiniqi shofet. D acu i d-yebɣa ad yini ?
themes.0.questions.7.explain: Shofet yebɣa ad yini « aḥakem ». Igrikiyen akked Iṛumaniyen semman i yimḥekmen-agi « igelliden » imi ulac awal yemsaɛdal, maca ur zgin ara lɛesker.
themes.0.questions.8.q: Anwa amusnaw agrikan i yesersen tinmahlin n Qarṭaǧ gar wid yelhan akteṛ, ɣer tama n Sparte akked Crète ?
themes.0.questions.8.explain: Deg Tasertit-ines (II, 11), Aristote yesmenyaf lḥekma-agi « yemsedwayen » : ur yettwaẓer ara dinna, akken i d-yeqqar, ne tikker ne bu lḥekma.
themes.0.questions.9.q: Anwa umḥekkem n Qarṭaǧ i yesmeyyan tikli n yimenzaway mi d-uɣalen seg teklal ?
themes.0.questions.9.explain: Imeqqa-Ṛebɛa (« Imeqqa » ɣer Justin), imḥekmen i yettwakksen seg Ssenaṭ, ḥekkmen ɣef yimenzaway. Ițwafernen uqbel ar lmut, uɣalen ițwafernen i useggas mbeɛd tiẓyawt n Hanibal deg 196.
themes.1.title: Hanibal akked yimenɣan
themes.1.desc: Limin, Idurar n Alpes, Trébie, Trasimène, Cannes, Zama akked krad n yimenɣan ipunikiyen.
themes.1.questions.0.q: Acḥal n iseggasen yesɛa Hanibal asmi yegall, afus-is ɣef umnar, ur ad yili ara d amddakel n Iṛumaniyen ?
themes.1.questions.0.explain: Deg 237 send Ɛisa, uqbel ad yeddu ɣer Hispanya, Hamilkar yesres limin ɣef mmi-s yesɛan ṭsaɛ iseggasen. Hanibal s yiman-is i d-yeḥka tadyant-agi i ugellid Antiochos III.
themes.1.questions.1.q: Aṭṭef n anwa tamdint, tamddakelt n Ṛuma, i yesnulfan amenɣi apunik wis sin deg 219 send Ɛisa ?
themes.1.questions.1.explain: Hanibal yeṭṭef Sagonte mbeɛd ṭsam wagguren n uḥeṛṣ, Ṛuma tesres amenɣi. Messine, netta, tella d tazwart n umenɣi amezwaru, deg 264.
themes.1.questions.2.q: Acḥal n ilfan i yewwi Hanibal mi yeffeɣ Hispanya, deg 218 send Ɛisa ?
themes.1.questions.2.explain: Hanibal yezger Idurar n Pyrénées imbeɛd Idurar n Alpes s 37 n ilfan. 80 n ilfan i yettwabedren aṭas d wid n Zama, deg 202.
themes.1.questions.3.q: Di Trébie (duǧembir 218), anwa i d-yeffɣen seg deffir n llejyunat iṛumaniyen s 2000 n yirgazen yeffren ?
themes.1.questions.3.explain: Hanibal yeffer gma-s Magun s 1000 n yiɛeskriyen n uḍar akked 1000 n yineggafen deg uɣelluy. Iṛumaniyen, εebban aman n wasif igerjjumen, ttwaṭṭfen seg deffir.
themes.1.questions.4.q: Anwa akunsul aṛumani i yemmuten deg tuffra n ilel n Trasimène, deg 217 send Ɛisa ?
themes.1.questions.4.explain: Yettwaṭṭef ger ilel d idurar, deg usigna n tufat, lɛesker n Flaminius yettwahdem : azal n 15 000 n Iṛumaniyen ttwanɣan, ula d akunsul. Paul Émile, netta, ad yemmet di Cannes.
themes.1.questions.5.q: Anwa tirrayt i yeggan Cannes (216 send Ɛisa) d amenɣi mazal yettwaɣren deg tesdawiyin n umenɣi ?
themes.1.questions.5.explain: Ammas apunik yesselkam war ma yerreẓ, iɛeskriyen n uḍar ilibikiyen ṭṭfen tama, ineggafen sekkṛen lkamin seg deffir : d azzel s snat n tama-s.
themes.1.questions.6.q: Acuɣer i yeṭṭef Fabius Maximus alqab « Cunctator », Win Yettwaxeṛṭalen ?
themes.1.questions.6.choices.3: Yesεeddi ɛecra iseggasen iwakken ad yeṭṭef Syracuse
themes.1.questions.6.explain: Yettwasemma d adiktatur mbeɛd Trasimène, Fabius yugi amenɣi usrid iwakken ad yeεya lɛesker n Hanibal. Tirrayt-agi tefka-d isem-is ula i Fabian Society tabritanit.
themes.1.questions.7.q: Di Zama (202 send Ɛisa), amek i gesenfesεel Scipion ilfan n Hanibal ?
themes.1.questions.7.choices.2: S lhuǧum n uɛessas-nsen uqbel umenɣi
themes.1.questions.7.explain: Ttwaεeṭlen s snasel n yiɣeḍ, ilfan ɛeddan deg yizirigen war lxesrat neɣ ttuɣalen mgal Iqarṭaǧiyen. Ineggafen n Lélius akked Masinisa i yefrazen amenɣi imbeɛd.
themes.1.questions.8.q: Anwa usnulfu i yeǧǧan Ṛuma, tezmert n wakal, ad teṭṭef tanyafit-ines tamezwarut n lebḥer di Mylae (260 send Ɛisa) ?
themes.1.questions.8.explain: Corvus yesbeddel amenɣi n lebḥer ɣer wemnuɣ n yiɛeskriyen n uḍar. Ṛuma tebna daɣen lebḥer-ines s usegzi n lbabur apuni yettwasersen ɣef tgaraf.
themes.1.questions.9.q: Anwa aṭant i tesres Ṛuma ɣef Qarṭaǧ s talwit n 201 send Ɛisa ?
themes.1.questions.9.explain: Amtawa n 201 yesres 10 000 n ttalan n nnuqra deg 50 n iseggasen, yeǧǧa kan 10 n trirèmes yegdel yal amenɣi war laṣel n Ṛuma. 3200 n ttalan llant d ssuma n umenɣi amezwaru.
themes.2.title: Addin d tgemmi
themes.2.desc: Baal Hammon, Tanit, Melqart, agemmay n 22 isekkilen, ismawen-tẓallit akked taẓuri tapunit.
themes.2.questions.0.q: Anwa illu, bab n igenni d usway, i yettwaskanen d amɣar yesɛan taɣmert ɣef ukersi yezzin fell-as sphinx ?
themes.2.questions.0.explain: Baal Hammon d illu aqerqur n Qarṭaǧ. Ddaw n Ṛuma, yeqqim yedder s udem n Saturne afrikan.
themes.2.questions.1.q: Amek i d-ssawalen izran n Qarṭaǧ i tyillut Tanit ?
themes.2.questions.1.explain: « I Tamɣart Tanit, udem n Baal, akked i Sidi Baal Hammon » : awal-agi yeldi amur ameqqran n izran. Acaraf-is — akradi, tagejdit, azellaw — yella yal amkan.
themes.2.questions.2.q: D acu i d-yebɣa ad yini isem n Melqart, illu i d-yekkan seg Ṣur ?
themes.2.questions.2.explain: Melqart, « agellid n temdint », yella d illu n Ṣur ; Qarṭaǧ tettazen-as yal aseggas asfel, At Barka gren-t ɣef idrimen-nsen.
themes.2.questions.3.q: Anwa illu n usijji i yesɛan lǥameɛ-ines ɣef tuyat n tiɣilt n Byrsa ?
themes.2.questions.3.explain: Lǥameɛ n Eshmoun, ameqqran akteṛ n Qarṭaǧ akken i d-yeqqar Appien, yeɣreḏ Byrsa. Wid ineggura n leḥras rewlen-d dinna deg 146.
themes.2.questions.4.q: Anwa tiyillutin tigrikiyin i teṭṭef Qarṭaǧ deg 396 send Ɛisa, mbeɛd ṭṭaɛun i yehlaken lɛesker-is di Sicile ?
themes.2.questions.4.explain: Lɛesker n Himilcon yeḥuddu amḍiq-nsent iqeddsen qrib Syracuse. Iwakken ad sεeddin tyillutin, Qarṭaǧ teṭṭef imahlen-nsent tefka-ten i lemqedmin igrikiyen (Diodore).
themes.2.questions.5.q: Acḥal n isekkilen i yesɛa ugemmay afiniqi ?
themes.2.questions.5.explain: Sin u ɛecrin n isekkilen, meṛṛa d inzizen : ulac ula d yiwet n ssekta i yettwabedren deg tira tafiniqit taqdimt.
themes.2.questions.6.q: Deg anwa idis i yettwaru ugemmay afiniqi ?
themes.2.questions.6.explain: Tafiniqit tettwaru seg uyeffus ɣer uzelmaḍ. Yeṭṭef sɣur Igrikiyen, i s-rnan inzizen, yella d aẓaṛ n ugemmay-nneɣ — akked, s taramit, n ugemmay aɛrab.
themes.2.questions.7.q: D acu i d-yebɣa ad yini isem apunik Hanibal ?
themes.2.questions.7.explain: Hanibal (Ḥnbʿl) yebɣa ad yini « lḥif n Baal ». Ismawen ipuniyen aṭas n tikwal d tẓallit tawezlant : Hasdrubal, « Baal d amεawan-iw » ; Hamilkar, « gma-s n Melqart ».
themes.2.questions.8.q: D acu i xeddmen ucenfiṛen yettemcaben n talaḥt i d-yettwafen di Qarṭaǧ ?
themes.2.questions.8.explain: Tiɣrad yeɣẓan, imi yettwaẓẓan : ucenfiṛen-agi, ahat d-kkan seg Ccerq, țwaseklaqen neɣ țwagren deg yimḍalen iwakken ad sfeḍen leǥnun.
themes.2.questions.9.q: Tira s snat n tutlayin n uzekka n Dougga tesdukkel tapunikt akked :
themes.2.questions.9.explain: Aḏris-agi s tapunikt d telibikit d tasarutt i ufran n tira talibikit. Yettwakkes deg 1842 sɣur ukunsul abritani Thomas Reade, yella deg British Museum.
themes.3.title: Tadamsa d tudert n wass ɣer wass
themes.3.desc: Aẓeɛfran, aqezdir, garum, adlis n Magun, ṭṭabla akked wexxam apunik.
themes.3.questions.0.q: Seg anwa ṣṣedfa i d-ksen Iqarṭaǧiyen aẓeɛfran ?
themes.3.questions.0.explain: Ilaq agar n murex i kra n yigramen n uzeɛfran. Di Kerkouane, igar n ṣṣedfa yettwarẓen sbeggnen-d lxiwanat n uẓeɛfran.
themes.3.questions.1.q: Deg acḥal n yidlisen i yura ameǥeri aqarṭaǧi Magun adlis-ines n tfellaḥt ?
themes.3.questions.1.explain: Adlis-agi n 28 n yidlisen d lxedma-nni kan tapunit i yesres Ssenaṭ aṛumani ad tettwasuɣel ɣer tlatinit, mbeɛd aṭṭef n Qarṭaǧ deg 146.
themes.3.questions.2.q: Anwa ameǥeri aṛumani i yessawalen i Magun « baba-s n tfellaḥt » ?
themes.3.questions.2.explain: « Magun Aqarṭaǧi, baba-s n tfellaḥt » (Columelle, I, 1, 13). Columelle yeḥrez daɣen talɣa-ines n passum, ccṛab n uẓalim yeqqur.
themes.3.questions.3.q: Akken i d-yeqqar Hérodote, amek sɣaṛen Iqarṭaǧiyen akked yigduden i yezgan deffir n Tgejdal n Hercule ?
themes.3.questions.3.choices.1: Sersen lxiwanat-nsen ɣef uglaḍ, war ma mmeslayen akked yimezdaɣ
themes.3.questions.3.explain: Iqarṭaǧiyen sersen lxiwanat-nsen rewlen ; imezdaɣ sersen ddheb ɣer tama. Ttɛawaden armi d lqerra — war lexdeɛ, akken i d-yeqqar Hérodote.
themes.3.questions.4.q: Acuɣer aqezdir n « Tegzirin n Cassitérides » yella aεzizen aṭas i Qarṭaǧ ?
themes.3.questions.4.choices.0: Ilaq bessif i uheggi n uzzal n ṣṣfeṛ
themes.3.questions.4.explain: War aqezdir, war azzal n ṣṣfeṛ. Yekka-d seg ugafa-agmur n Turuft, yeḍfeṛ abrid agmaṛan i yesnirem Himilcon, Qarṭaǧ teḥrez ssir-ines s telqey.
themes.3.questions.5.q: D acu i d garum, i yesfeṛqen umaḏal apunik aseqdec-ines deg Lebḥer Ageraɣlan ?
themes.3.questions.5.explain: Garum, lqut n uslem yesɛan dhen, yettwaseqdac deg uṭṭbib akked deg wučči. Ṛuma ad tt-taɛraḏ s lmeqyas ameqqran.
themes.3.questions.6.q: Anwa lɣella i gessawalen Iṛumaniyen malum punicum, « tazart tapunit » ?
themes.3.questions.6.explain: Ṛṛumman, yettwazzan deg yiferkiwen n Qarṭaǧ ɣer tama n ttejra n tazart akked uluz, yesɛa isem-agi ɣer Iṛumaniyen.
themes.3.questions.7.q: Akken i d-yeqqar Pline, d acu i d-yesken Caton deg Ssenaṭ iwakken ad yesken Qarṭaǧ ur telli ara ala krad wussan n lebḥer ?
themes.3.questions.7.explain: Tazart, mazal-itt tafrint, tesken-d aεdaw iqrib. Caton yesmed taɣect-is s « Carthago delenda est » : ilaq ad tettwahdem Qarṭaǧ.
themes.3.questions.8.q: « Puls punica » i d-yefka Caton talɣa-ines d taɛsimt n yirden yemsedwayen akked :
themes.3.questions.8.explain: Caton (De agricultura, 85) yesmeslay yiwet lṭar n alica akked ikkil amaynut, tamment d tmellalt. D talɣa taṛumanit « s wudem apunik », mačči s laṣel lmakla n wass ɣer wass n Iqarṭaǧiyen.
themes.3.questions.9.q: Anwa amḍiq, idris deg ddunit taqdimt n zzman-nni, i yettwafen deg aṭas n ixxamen n Kerkouane ?
themes.3.questions.9.choices.0: Taxxamt n waman s tɣawsa n uɣessel
themes.3.questions.9.explain: Aṭas n ixxamen sɛan taxxamt tamecṭuḥt n waman s tɣawsa n uɣessel, s ukersi. Yal axxam yesɛa daɣen lǥab-is ițčaṭen s waman n ugeffur.
themes.4.title: Udmawen
themes.4.desc: At Barka, Sofonisba, Hanun Bu Lebḥer, Masinisa akked Hanun Ameqqran.
themes.4.questions.0.q: D acu i d-yebɣa ad yini alqab Barka n Hamilkar, i d-yekkan seg wawal apunik baraq ?
themes.4.questions.0.explain: Barka yezmer ad d-yekka seg baraq, « lebraq ». Ur yettwanɣi ara di Sicile, Hamilkar yettwaḥseb sɣur Polybe d anezwi ilhan akteṛ n umenɣi apunik amezwaru.
themes.4.questions.1.q: Amek yemmut Hamilkar Barka, deg 229/228 send Ɛisa ?
themes.4.questions.1.choices.1: Yeswa aẓiḏi s lameṛ n Ssenaṭ
themes.4.questions.1.choices.2: Yeɣleb deg wasif yeṭṭef lḥerz n urewl n warraw-is
themes.4.questions.1.choices.3: Yettwanɣa deg umenɣi ɣer Tegzirin n Égates
themes.4.questions.1.explain: Yettwaxdeɛ sɣur agellid n Orissi deg uḥebbes n Héliké, di Hispanya, yeɣleb yeḥṛes urewl n warraw-is. D yiri-s Hasdrubal Ucbiḥ i d-ittwanɣan netta, sɣur Agali deg 221.
themes.4.questions.2.q: Anwa i yesresen, azal n 227 send Ɛisa, Qart-Ḥadašt, Carthagène i d-iteddun, di Hispanya ?
themes.4.questions.2.explain: Argaz n yelli-s n Hamilkar, Hasdrubal Ucbiḥ yesres « Tamdint tamaynut », taneddawt n Hispanya n At Barka, qrib lmɛadin n nnuqra. Hamilkar, netta, yesres Akra Leukè.
themes.4.questions.3.q: Anida yemmut Hasdrubal Barka deg 207 send Ɛisa, mi yeεreḏ ad yaweḍ ɣer gma-s Hanibal di Italya ?
themes.4.questions.3.explain: Hasdrubal yezger daɣen Idurar n Alpes, maca akunsul Néron yawi-d 7000 n yiɛeskriyen imenyafen s tazla. Yettwanɣa deg Métaure ; aqerru-s yettwagr zdat uɛessas n Hanibal.
themes.4.questions.4.q: D acu i d-yawi Magun Barka ɣer Ssenaṭ n Qarṭaǧ iwakken ad yesken tanyafit n Cannes ?
themes.4.questions.4.choices.1: Lxwatem n ddheb n ifariten iṛumaniyen yettwanɣan
themes.4.questions.4.explain: Yesres ɣef tewwurt n Ssenaṭ lxwatem n ddheb, acaraf n imenyafen n Ṛuma. Hanun yemmeslay s lehzel : ma Hanibal yenɣelb, acuɣer yessuter irgazen d idrimen ?
themes.4.questions.5.q: Anwa lebḥer n Jzayer Baléares i d-yekkan isem-is seg Magun Barka, i yesteεfan dinna deg 206/205 send Ɛisa ?
themes.4.questions.5.explain: Yettwarra sɣur imegrragen di Majorque, Magun yers di Minorque yesteεfu dinna. Tamacahut tefka isem n Mahón seg Portus Magonis, « lebḥer n Magun ».
themes.4.questions.6.q: Anwa igelliden inumidiyen i tzewǧeḏ Sofonisba, yiwen mbeɛd wayeḍ ?
themes.4.questions.6.explain: Tettunefk i Syphax iwakken ad tsedduklet tagelda tanumidit, tzewǧeḏ Masinisa deg wass n Aɣelli n Cirta, deg 203. Yessuter-itt Scipion i triyunf-is, teswa aẓiḏi.
themes.4.questions.7.q: Anwa awal, yekkan seg Tiklarit n Hanun, i yettwaseqdacen deg 1847 ad yesmi azger ameqqran n Tafrikt ?
themes.4.questions.7.explain: Tiklarit tḥekku-d ɣef lḥiwanat s ccɛeṛ i ssemman yimsefhamen « ilfan n lǥab ». Imusnawen n lǥetta Savage akked Wyman qeblen awal-agi i wezger ameqqran n ammas n Tafrikt.
themes.4.questions.8.q: Anida yesselmad Masinisa, agellid n Numidya i d-iteddun, akken i d-yeqqar Appien ?
themes.4.questions.8.explain: Yesselmad di Qarṭaǧ, yennuɣ fell-as uqbel di Hispanya, imbeɛd yeddu ɣer Ṛuma deg 206 yefrez tanyafit n Zama s ineggafen-ines.
themes.4.questions.9.q: Mbeɛd uṭṭef n Sagonte, d acu i gessumer Hanun Ameqqran i Ssenaṭ n Qarṭaǧ, akken i d-yeqqar Tite-Live ?
themes.4.questions.9.explain: Aɛdaw n At Barka, Hanun yesnekkeṛ talwit yettwagallen, yessumer ad yefk Hanibal iwakken ad yegri amenɣi. Ssenaṭ yextar amenɣi.
themes.5.title: Qarṭaǧ d Tunisia n wassa
themes.5.desc: Isem n Tafrikt, Kairouan, axxam alḥakimi, UNESCO akked talwit yettwagren akked Ṛuma deg 1985.
themes.5.questions.0.q: Seg wanda i d-yekka isem n umurig afrikan ?
themes.5.questions.0.choices.0: Seg Ifri, isem i gfkan Iṛumaniyen i yimezdaɣ n tama n Qarṭaǧ
themes.5.questions.0.choices.3: Seg yisem agrikan n ucenfiṛ n Gibraltar
themes.5.questions.0.explain: Mbeɛd 146 send Ɛisa, Ṛuma tesres tamanaḏt n Africa deg ugafa-agmaṛ n Tunisia n wassa. Aẓaṛ n wawal Afri, netta, mazal-it ittwasmeyya.
themes.5.questions.1.q: Deg lqern wis 7, tamanaḏt taqdimt n Africa tuɣal d Ifriqiya. D acu i d taneddawt-ines ?
themes.5.questions.1.explain: Isem yuɣal d Ifriqiya, s Kairouan d taneddawt. Ass-a, isem n tmanaḏt-agi tatunsit yesseknen umurig meṛṛa n 54 n tmura.
themes.5.questions.2.q: Mbeɛd uṭṭef n Qarṭaǧ sɣur Hassan Ibn Numan deg 698, ɣer anwa tamdint i ɛeddan imezdaɣ-is ?
themes.5.questions.2.explain: Tamdint, tettwahelki tettwasserɣ, tettwakkes seg yimezdaɣ-is, i yεeddan ɣer Tunes. Tunes tuɣal d tamdint tagejdant ad tefk isem-is i tmurt.
themes.5.questions.3.q: Deg anwa aseggas i yettwajerred umḍiq asenfarrutan n Qarṭaǧ deg lwert agraɣlan n UNESCO ?
themes.5.questions.3.explain: Ajerred yekka-d deg 1979. Yeḍfeṛ teklal tagraɣlant tameqqrant iwakken ad tsellek Qarṭaǧ, i d-tezzi UNESCO deg 1972 zdat n uɣerbaz.
themes.5.questions.4.q: Anwa tinmahla i yezzun ass-a deg uxxam n Qarṭaǧ ?
themes.5.questions.4.explain: Deg 1960, Bourguiba yegg seg uxxam n zzman uḥekkam, ɣer rrif n lebḥer, axxam alḥakimi. Tunes teḥrez tinmahla d tedamsa.
themes.5.questions.5.q: D acu i d alqab n tarbaɛt taɣelnawt tatunsit n ddecra n uḍar ?
themes.5.questions.5.explain: « Igedwan n Qarṭaǧ » : sin u ɛecrin iqrunen mbeɛd 146 send Ɛisa, isem n temdint tapunit yeqqim d acaraf n Tunisia.
themes.5.questions.6.q: Anwa tadyant, yettwasersen deg 1966, d tasuɣit tiqdimt akteṛ n ssinima n Tafrikt d umaḏal aɛrab ?
themes.5.questions.6.explain: Ussan Isinimatugrafiyen n Qarṭaǧ llan seg 1966. Tesuɣit Tagraɣlant n Qarṭaǧ (1964), netta, tedduṛu yal unebdu deg ṭṭiyaṭru aqdim.
themes.5.questions.7.q: D acu i gran deg 1985 ineddawen n Ṛuma d Qarṭaǧ, Ugo Vetere akked Chedli Klibi ?
themes.5.questions.7.choices.1: Amtawa n talwit n lemtel yesekkṛen amenɣi apunik wis krad
themes.5.questions.7.explain: Ugar n 2100 n iseggasen mbeɛd 146 send Ɛisa, amtawa-agi n lemtel yesekkeṛ s wudem amagnu amenɣi apunik wis krad.
themes.5.questions.8.q: Teẕẕa Ṛuma lmelḥ ɣef lxrab n Qarṭaǧ deg 146 send Ɛisa ?
themes.5.questions.8.choices.0: Yes, akken i d-yeqqar Polybe, acehhed n uḥeṛṣ
themes.5.questions.8.choices.1: Yes, maca kan ɣef tiɣilt n Byrsa
themes.5.questions.8.choices.3: Ala : ula d yiwen uɣbalu aqdim ur t-yebder, d asnulfu atrar
themes.5.questions.8.explain: Tamdint tettwasserɣ akal-is yettwanɛal, maca taqsist n lmelḥ teḍhiṛ-d sɣur imeskaren iwerupiyen n leqrun wis 19–20. Ṛuma tesres daɣen Qarṭaǧ lqern mbeɛd.
themes.5.questions.9.q: Akked anwa tamdint n Lubnan, i deg trewl Elisa, i tegg Qarṭaǧ tagmatt-is seg 2002 ?
themes.5.questions.9.explain: Qarṭaǧ tegg daɣen tagmatt-is akked Carthagène (1989), Qart-Ḥadašt-nniḍen, akked Aix-en-Provence (1993) d Versailles (1998).
